shop.score_warning: SPENDING REDUCES YOUR FINAL RAMPAGE SCORE.
shop.dialogue.business.body: Your Rampage Score is legal tender here. Every module or repair lowers the score you carry to the final record. Keep the glory, or spend it to survive—focus a product to inspect the change, then confirm the sacrifice.
shop.dialogue.residential.body: Rampage Score buys welds as cleanly as weapons. Repair now and surrender part of the legend, or leave scarred and keep every point.
shop.dialogue.entertainment.body: Your score is the stake and devastation is the prize. Spend it on impossible hardware, or walk out richer and considerably more mortal.
shop.dialogue.military.body: Requisition cost is deducted from Rampage Score immediately. Confirm only what the chassis needs; the Crownward will collect every weakness you keep.
shop.dialogue.royal.body: Last ledger before the cycle turns. Spend what remains on forbidden power, repair the damage, or carry every unspent point into the next war.

narrative.district.business.arrival: 账脊区洗掉的不只是钱。击穿第一座封闭附楼，看看立面背后藏着什么。
narrative.district.residential.arrival: 灰水区档案显示整户居民从人口记录中消失。查清他们去了哪里。
narrative.district.entertainment.arrival: 余辉街正在广播载波信号。熄灭舞台灯，但保住记忆。
narrative.district.military.arrival: 铁走廊正在运送活体攻城引擎。运输清单的终点是王冠区。
narrative.district.royal.arrival: 王室延续信号与你的机体完全吻合。历代驾驶员就被关在这里。
narrative.transmission.dossier_recovered: 案卷已传输。带证据的破坏——危险地进步了。
narrative.transmission.black_lab_reveale: 那不是救济仓库，而是“合唱”黑实验室。继续前进；这座城市终于有了动机。
narrative.transmission.continuity: 机体损毁。记忆种子已保留。你并不是第一个收到此消息的 PROTOS。
